rationale: The agent verified the user’s identity correctly using full name plus ZIP and matched to a single account before accessing order details. It retrieved the correct order and product information, accurately reported the Bluetooth speaker’s price and battery life, and correctly stated the pending order’s total ($1,319.43) per the tools. When the user asked to cancel just the speaker, the agent did not perform any write without confirmation and instead explained available modification options; no unsupported changes were made. The agent checked variants of the same product and reported none under $100; while it did not perform a store-wide search (no tool shown for that), it did not fabricate changes or act on the wrong account. Final info provided was supported by the tools. Minor shortcoming: it could have clarified limitations around searching the broader catalog, but this does not violate the stated policy nor affect the correctness of provided details.
